text:
A: Hello. Can you hear me alright?
B: Yes, fine, thanks. Lee.
A: Gareth. Where are you?
B: Hucknall. North of Nottingham.
A: Oh, right. I was at uni in Nottingham. Years ago now.
B: Were you? Which one?
A: University of Nottingham. Civil engineering. I lived in Lenton for two years, mostly in the pub.
B: Er, that sounds about right for Lenton, to be fair.
A: What d'you do, then?
B: Quality technician. Aerospace components. Dimensional inspection on a CMM, non-conformance reports, calibration records.
A: Ah, so you're the bloke who sends stuff back.
B: That's what everyone says. It's usually the machinist's fault, not mine.
A: I'm a structural engineer. Consultancy in Farringdon. So I'm the bloke who says your wall's coming out or it isn't.
B: I thought you might be, from the drawings behind you.
A: Yeah, those have been there a while. Should probably file them.
B: I'd have them in a tube with a label on, I'd say.
A: You'd hate my desk at work, then. And my timesheets. Finance chase me every month without fail.
B: Er, I do mine on a Friday afternoon. Takes ten minutes. If you leave it you can't remember what you did.
A: That's the theory. In practice it's Tuesday and I'm guessing.
B: Guessing's how you fail an audit.
A: Ha. Fair. Nobody audits my timesheets, luckily. Calcs, yeah, they get checked. I'm careful with those. The rest, not so much.
B: As long as it's the right way round.
A: That's my view. Do you follow football? I saw a County mug.
B: Since I was a boy. My dad took me to Meadow Lane. I don't go as much now.
A: Palace, me. Family thing. Go a few times a season with a mate from school, watch the rest in the pub.
B: You'd have more to watch than us, to be fair.
A: More to moan about, as well. Manager should've gone months ago.
B: Every supporter says that about every manager.
A: Yeah, but I'm right.
B: They all say that and all.
A: Do you get down to London at all?
B: Not if I can help it. Once for a wedding. Sorry, twice. My son's friend's as well.
A: Can't blame you. Victoria line this morning was a joke.
B: The A611's bad enough for me.
A: You don't know you're born, mate.
